projectDesc.p: Text digitized and encoded for use in the Forager Folklore Database.

body.p: One day the puma felt like eating a deer, but he was afraid since he did not know whether the deer had teeth. He decided to make the deer laugh so he turned around and showed his bottom, but the deer did not laugh. Then the puma showed his penis and the deer began to laugh. The puma saw that the deer had no teeth and so pursued and killed him. He ate one half of the deer immediately and hid the rest.
